name: Workspan
author: Ryan Brosas
description: Local working-time accounting: attested sessions, inferred attended windows and agent runtime, kept separate and never added together.

barWidget.description: Tracked work from the local daemon: attested session, inferred attended windows and agent runtime, with coverage warnings. Strictly a display: the daemon owns all state.

schema.label: Workspan CLI
schema.description: Executable used for session controls. A checkout can point at a wrapper script instead.

schema.label: Session project
schema.description: Client or project attributed when a session is started from the bar. Empty starts an unallocated session rather than guessing.
